ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade, multilingual AI health platform featuring rPPG remote heart rate sensing and localized triage for semi-urban regions.
ideas.problem_statement: Medical & HealthTech track: Addressing accessibility gaps in rural healthcare through rapid AI triage.
ideas.title: MediScan Rural Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of clear measurable impact and a working live demo using computer vision for rPPG sensing, directly fitting the Medical & HealthTech domain.

ideas.pitch: A biomechanical cricket shot analyzer using MediaPipe Pose and XGBoost with confidence gating to provide real-time coaching feedback.
ideas.problem_statement: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning track: Practical computer vision applications for specialized sports biomechanics.
ideas.title: BioKinetic Cricket Form Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages genuinely hard engineering in pose estimation and machine learning classification, matching a proven hackathon-winning architecture.

ideas.pitch: An automated anti-money laundering risk detection and investigation platform combining graph intelligence and gradient-boosted decision trees.
ideas.problem_statement: FinTech track: Combating financial fraud through advanced pattern recognition and graph analytics.
ideas.title: GraphGuard AML Risk Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets high-value FinTech security problems by utilizing complex graph intelligence, directly reflecting a 1st place winning architecture.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered application that coordinates and groups nearby senior citizens into social outings with verified volunteer drivers.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Cities & Social Impact track: Solving social isolation and mobility challenges for the elderly population.
ideas.title: SeniorLink Community Carpool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an urgent social issue with clear measurable impact and an intuitive matching workflow, mirroring a grand prize-winning concept.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered clinical training application featuring rubric-scored patient interviews and camera-based real-time CPR compression coaching.
ideas.problem_statement: Human-AI & Assistive Technology track: Enhancing emergency response training through interactive multimodal AI.
ideas.title: MediSim CPR Coach
